sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Improve Your Eating Habits]

sentences.text: Healthy eating is important for a healthy body and mind.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Healthy eating is important for a healthy body and mind.]

sentences.text: Both what we eat and how we eat are important!
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Both what we eat and how we eat are important!]

sentences.text: For example, some people have fast food every week.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: For example, some people have fast food every week.]
[需要翻译: It is easy and delicious!]

sentences.text: But it often has lots of salt, fat, and sugar.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: But it often has lots of salt, fat, and sugar.]

sentences.text: That makes us put on weight.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: That makes us put on weight.]

sentences.text: Eating fast food like pizza and hamburgers too often may cause heart problems later.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Eating fast food like pizza and hamburgers too often may cause heart problems later.]

sentences.text: If you cook your own meals instead, you can make healthy balanced meals.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: If you cook your own meals instead, you can make healthy balanced meals.]

sentences.text: Eating three meals a day is important.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Eating three meals a day is important.]

sentences.text: But some people don’t have breakfast.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: But some people don’t have breakfast.]
